response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with a long track record across web, backend, and systems programming, but the profile does not match this role's core requirements. His experience centers on TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, with only incidental Java exposure and no evident Kotlin, Spring, or enterprise JVM framework experience. While his brief IDE work at National Instruments (C/C++ on LabWindows/CVI) and developer-tooling interest are relevant signals, they are insufficient for a role demanding deep JVM expertise and Spring ecosystem knowledge.
strengths: Prior hands-on IDE development experience (NI LabWindows/CVI) and genuine interest in developer tooling
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, open-source test frameworks, high-performance low-latency systems work
Broad, long-tenured experience across stacks, plus teaching/workshop background indicating good communication skills
concerns: No demonstrated Kotlin or Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate experience — core requirements of the role
Java appears only as a peripheral skill; primary depth is in TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, not the JVM
No evidence of work on enterprise build tools, application servers, or JVM language tooling
